clues.text: Riders are launched up to a brisk 62 mph, reaching a height of 125 feet while turning upside down through 4 inversions.
Manufactured by Mack, this steel creation originally made its debut in 2009.
You will find this coaster operating in Germany, anchoring an Iceland-themed section of the park.
This attraction made history as the very first launched coaster built by Mack Rides, as well as the first coaster at its park to include inversions.
The name of this coaster evokes an intensely hot, azure flame.

evidence.quote: '''Blue Fire Megacoaster''' is a [[steel]] [[launched]] [[roller coaster]] located at [[Europa-Park]] in Rust, Baden Wuerttemberg, Germany.
As the first launched coaster built by Mack Rides, Blue Fire was the park's tenth roller coaster and the first to feature inversions.
